evidence.text: builds `%s\data\sound.dat`, walks the 0x24-byte sample records at `DAT_0015224`, builds `%s.RAW` for each name, and opens the member through the member open `0x4c08d`; a failed open reports the file error and runs the exit 0

the rebuild copies the 0x74-byte record template, reads every member through the `SOUND_FX` resource at `0x2eed0`, and maps the high nibble of `+0x20` to the type 0, 2, 1, and 3; the five behavior paths cover the setup gate, the two records, the four status values, the two failed opens, and the zero resource

name: sound_bank_load
role: loads `DATA/SOUND.DAT` into the 0x74-byte sample records at `DAT_0016034`: builds the member names, opens each member, reads it through the `SOUND_FX` resource, and sets the type and the flags
